message: A symmetric triangular roof truss spans 15m. Its bottom chord has five 3m panels, and its straight roof slopes pass through top nodes at (x,z) = (3,1), (6,2), (7.5,2.5), (9,2), and (12,1) m. Provide verticals at x = 3, 6, 9, and 12m; add diagonals from bottom x = 3m to top x = 6m, from bottom x = 6m and 9m to the apex, and from bottom x = 12m to top x = 9m. Use a pin at x = 0 and a roller at x = 15m. Apply a 10kN downward nodal load at each of the five top nodes and run static analysis.
